audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-2].side and phases[5-6].side all read 'Skill', contradicting the packet levelChart (Neeko,Neeko,Neeko,Skill,Skill,Taric,Taric) and the content layer's own win[0-2]='Neeko'/win[5-6]='Taric', which already state the correct verdict.
audit.why: Neeko's ranged Q-E poke and root outrange Taric's melee Q heal levels 1-3, and Taric's Bastion sustain plus E stun overtake her squishy poke kit after first item and late — the content layer already says this, the full layer's side/rating never caught up.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side/rating -> Neeko/3.5-10 style rating reflecting enemy favor; phases[1].side -> Neeko; phases[2].side -> Neeko; phases[5].side -> Taric; phases[6].side -> Taric. whys rewritten to match.

audit.why: Level 6 spike (Cosmic Radiance cancels Pop Blossom), first item (Bastion double-Q sustain), and late (R+E lockdown vs squishy disguise kit) are already stated correctly in spikes[] and phases — kept as-is.

R Cosmic Radiance (invulnerability) vs R Pop Blossom (AoE stun-nuke) interaction is correctly stated: Taric's R cancels the burst outright if timed on her jump. E Tangle-Barbs (Root) as the setup ability to dodge is correctly flagged throughout.

edits.before: He pokes the gems — weave the heals through the chip and R the conversion his zone funds.
edits.after: She pokes the gems — weave the heals through the chip and R the conversion her zone funds.

edits.before: He pokes the gems — weave the heals through the chip and R the conversion his zone funds.
edits.after: She pokes the gems — weave the heals through the chip and R the conversion her zone funds.

edits.before: Commit on Tangle-Barbs (Root)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Tangle-Barbs (Root)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Taric's E stun lands clean once Neeko dumps her root — it's down 10-12s by rank, so commit the moment it whiffs.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Front-line E gives Neeko a clean Q-E lane on you — flank through fog so Blooming Burst can't line up.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. It writes your spacing rules. - R Cosmic Radiance is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root) is down 12-10s by rank — matchup-defining, sets up her whole burst, so sidestep it behind minions. R Cosmic Radiance (180/150/120s) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades — one save or one all-in per cast, never both.

edits.before: Bravado-weave the trades — the empowered autos refund cooldowns; the loop is the lane.
edits.after: Her Q-E poke outranges your melee Q heal — Bravado-weave what trades you take, but you're not winning this exchange.

edits.before: Q-charges bank heals: the gemstone economy opens.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs (Root) locks your ADC from range while Q-charges only bank heals — the gemstone economy opens too slow to answer it.

edits.before: Full kit: W-link the carry and the E stuns from two bodies — the double angle is the trap.
edits.after: Full kit lets her chain Q-E from range faster than your sustain keeps pace — W-link the carry and hold E for the moment she overextends.

edits.before: First item: the stuns chain and the heals compound.
edits.after: First item: Bastion double-Q sustain out-heals her mana-gated poke, and a landed E stun tilts the exchange to you.

edits.before: Late Taric un-kills teamfights: R the dive, link the carry, and stun the formation twice per rotation.
edits.after: Late Taric un-kills teamfights against her squishy disguise kit: R the dive, link the carry, and stun before her single combo lands.
